title: Finding Registry Entry
description: One JSON object per line in findings.jsonl. Hash-chained append-only state store for every CATCHER-produced finding in the enterprise-v2 review cycle. Consumed by tools/gates/finding-registry.ts CLI (Phase 2), commit-msg-validator.ts (Phase 2), finding-state-sweep.yml (Phase 6 cron), and root-cause-auditor (Phase 5).

id.description: Finding ID per _shared/output-format.md. Format: {PREFIX}-{CLASSIFIER}-{NNN}. CLASSIFIER is usually severity (CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW); CVE is a separate classifier for findings sourced from CVE databases (RUSTSEC/GHSA etc.) whose identity is upstream-stable even as severity mutates. P0 reserved for Phase-0 audit bootstrap. PRODUCT-* reserved for test-agents lane-B (Phase 13). DEPLOY-* reserved for deploy-resilience findings (ADR-016 class). RUST-* reserved for Rust sidecar (sens-api-gateway, sensor-ingestion) findings. Other prefixes match agent finding-id-prefix sections.

severity.description: Match severity in the id field.

state.description: Lifecycle state. OPEN = raised, no commit. IN-PROGRESS = in an implementation-planner package. RESOLVED = merged commit carries matching Closes: line. STALE = 30 days OPEN without movement. BLOCKED = escalated to architectural-arbiter or awaiting override.

title.description: One-line human-readable summary. Hard cap raised from 200 to 400 chars to accommodate INFRA-* + DEPLOY-* entries whose titles legitimately span multiple causes (e.g. 'Migration X failed because of Y AND Z, blocking deploy round N'). Above 400 chars, decompose into multiple findings.

layer.description: Layer-1 (tech) / Layer-2 (pattern) / Layer-3 (ADR) per the 3-layer knowledge model. Layers 4 and 5 admitted for cross-layer findings used by INFRA-* + RUST-CVE-* entries (4 = ops/infra concern, 5 = supply-chain/CVE). Optional — not every finding fits the layer taxonomy.

evidence.description: Evidence citation — a human-readable reference to the offending location. Canonical forms: 'file:line', 'file:start-end', 'file:test_name', 'file (test_name)', 'file#anchor', or just 'file' for code; 'GitHub Actions run NNN' / 'Deploy log run NNN' for CI artefacts; 'log: <quoted-line>' for runtime log evidence; 'docker-compose.droplet.yml:162 image timescale/...' for compound config citations. The schema enforces only that the value is non-blank with at least 3 characters; finer-grained validation would over-constrain the natural variety of evidence forms (each with legitimate use). At least one evidence entry required for CRITICAL/HIGH per the allOf rule below — the WHAT-is-cited check, not the HOW-it-is-formatted check, is the load-bearing invariant.

rule_violated.description: Named rule: ADR number + title, ESLint rule ID, CLAUDE.md section, or layer-1/2/3 entry.

owner_agent.description: Agent that raised the finding. Must be a name in orchestrator.md runtime roster.

raised_in_cycle.description: Review cycle identifier — YYYY-MM-DD-{topic} matching docs/reviews/{agent}/{file}.md naming.

review_file.description: Path to the review markdown file that first documented this finding. Relative to repo root.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of first state transition to OPEN.

closed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of transition to RESOLVED. null while not RESOLVED.

closing_commits.description: Git SHAs of commits whose message contains 'Closes: ...#<this-id>'. Populated by closes-footer-check workflow.

deadline.description: Deadline for BLOCKED state (override protocol) or for tracked planner packages. null otherwise.

owner_user.description: GitHub handle accountable for closing. Required when state is BLOCKED.

override_of.description: If this entry represents an auditor-override (a Tier-4 exception tracked via inline comment), this field points to the underlying finding ID being overridden. null otherwise.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous entry's content_hash (64 zeros for the first entry). Enables tamper-evident append-only chain.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of this entry's JSON serialization with prev_hash and content_hash fields excluded. Computed and stamped at write time by tools/gates/finding-registry.ts CLI.

notes.description: Free-text notes. No structural requirements; avoid sensitive data — the jsonl is committed to the repo.

narrative.description: Free-form multi-paragraph context entries, captured when an incident note is too large for a single `notes` string and is not a precise `file:line` citation that belongs in `evidence`. Optional companion to `evidence`; `evidence` remains the canonical locus for file:line references.
